channel.title: Interpretable Machine Learning Lab
channel.description: Interactive write-ups from the Interpretable Machine Learning Lab at Duke University, whose PI is Cynthia Rudin. The lab designs machine learning models whose reasoning processes people can understand: extremely sparse models, interpretable neural networks, interpretable matching methods for causal inference, and dimension reduction for data visualization.

item.title: Understanding PaCMAP
item.description: A practitioner's guide to PaCMAP: when it beats t-SNE and UMAP, the five lines of code you need, what the three hyperparameters actually do, how to read the resulting plot without over-reading it, and which follow-up method to reach for when PaCMAP is not the right tool.
